title: Approximation to Gaussian boundary data
statement: For each natural number $q$, there is a natural number $r$ such that the upper-tail indicator of the normalized Rademacher sum on the $(r+1)$-dimensional sign cube, at the Gaussian upper-tail quantile corresponding to mass $1/(q+2)$, has mean within half that mass of $1/(q+2)$. Its total Fourier weight at level one is also within half the square of the Gaussian density at that quantile of that squared density.
